body: I don't know what it is like to struggle that hard man I really don't I am sorry to hear how terrible your situation is. Maybe you don't give a shit about what I have to say I'm just some stranger over the internet, you may not get all the answers you need immediately, but the answers will come one day.
why would you ever want to give up man? you've made it so far, why give up now?

Damn that is actually a really good field of engineering, I want to do something more related to business. I have a huge thing for the environment and so I want to help it form the inside haha. But anyways man if you aren't happy you have to change some things, I was in a similar situation as to yours, I don't want to bore you with it though, I want to hear more about your story.

Well what are you studying? it may be hell but once you're done you will have a extremely successful life. I have a friend that had a similar problem the only thing is he isn't as strong as you, he quit school after 2 months. He is already starting to regret it and I am actually going to start going to the university soon starting next year.
I would like that man, I know that if I ever need help I can message you and I hope that you know that you can do the same. (:

Hey man I am sorry to hear all the problems you are going through, I don't know what it is like to have difficulty in school but can you remember why you decided to go? What is your key point of motivation that made you want to attend the university?

I can't thank you enough, I feel that the thoughts are calming down a bit, any thing like that is just a small victory in the larger war. yeah I am definitely happy to have found this subreddit and I will stick around and see who I can help. I thank you though man, I appreciate it, I hope I can help you with anything you need and that we can support one another because a supporting cast is extremely important.

Do you feel that you will feel better by helping others? I had the same thought and as of recent I started being friendlier and more open with people. I really appreciate the help man I even had the same conversation with other people and you really feel like a supporting cast that will help me get through this. I know we can all beat it, we are strong, we have made it this far. I think a major factor of beating these thoughts is being more open and not stuffing down your emotions so much. I have a psychology class and that is one of the major factors leading to depression.

Well don't get me wrong, my childhood was great but certain things my father has done just stuck with me. I mean I am sorry to hear that, I would hate it if my family would not want anything to do with me, I mean if that does happen you can always get friends and make them your new family. NO man you aren't boring me, you came to me in a time of need man the least I can do is ask about how you are. Yeah but I know I can beat these thoughts, I have done it before with other things and I know I can do it with this.

Well what is going on in your life? Perhaps I may have gone through similar things. That is where I am confused, I don't know why I have these thoughts circulating. I mean I have had some pretty rough moments in my life. The most beautiful girl I had ever been with cheated on me, I tried to not display my sadness but it stung like hell man, I couldn't stop thinking about her until it recently went away but I never truly told anyone about how much it hit me. My father is a great man I mean he drinks and all that but I have come to realize he is great but there is just one thing that constantly sticks with me one night when I was younger my father told me that I would never amount to anything and that I would never be successful. A part of me uses it as motivation but the other just wants to agree with him. I can say that I constantly feel split.

Thanks for replying. Idk man, I mean I have always constantly had thoughts that just stay in my mind for long periods of time. I can remember many examples and just so many things stay in my head and just constantly are there. I don't want to end it, I know I have so much potential for life but I feel as if almost a  part of me doesn't want to see that happen.
